chunks: Surely your Lord will decide between them about what they were at variance, on the Day of Resurrection.
ai.seo_question: How does Allah resolve the disputes of people on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah’s absolute authority as the ultimate arbiter (Al-Hakam) who resolves not only theological disputes but also the nuanced differences in jurisprudence and belief that characterized the early Ummah. It serves as a reminder that while human interpretation may vary, the final verdict on truth and error rests solely with the Divine on the Day of Resurrection, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (Adl).
